Outlook Project is a YouTube channel on economics that I am preparing. It has not started yet.

The plan is to publish long conversations, of 45 to 70 minutes, with researchers and people who work in fiscal institutions, and shorter episodes, of 15 to 25 minutes, on current questions of European fiscal policy. The channel will be in Spanish.

I have in mind people who follow fiscal policy closely without being specialists: staff at fiscal councils and supervisors, economists in research departments, journalists, and university students and lecturers.

I will add the link here when the first episode is out.
